'''Chull''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]].

==Biography==
Around [[3640 BBY]], Chull was stationed at the [[Kri-Ta Outpost]] in the [[Pelath-Ri Marches]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]] when the [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] have stolen vital advanced power cores to use in their war machines against the [[Voss]]. Chull tasked a Republic citizen to recover the power cores before the Gormak could fashion them into weaponry.
